theorems.name: Submission.ae_of_ae_on_submanifold_charts
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M N₀ : Set (Rn N)) (S : ℕ → Set (Rn N)) (Q : Rn N → Prop), μHE[n] N₀ = 0 → (∀ j, IsC1Submanifold n (S j)) → M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ j, S j → (∀ (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → (∀ u ∈ V, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ u)) → ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), u ∈ V → ψ u ∈ M → Q (ψ u)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Rn N)), x ∈ M → Q x
